Name: Calm Colored Purple Cat
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
As the title says, this mod changes the orange cat to a purple one.

Instructions:
[font=monospace, monospace][size=4][b]Backup your cat.xnb file.
[/b][/size][/font]Download whichever version you want. (white or black eyes.)
Open the zip file.
Move the cat.xnb file into [code]Stardew Valley/Content/Animals
[/code]Replace the file.
Open Stardew Valley and enjoy!
